steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Conservative Party: centre-right, supports free market capitalism, low taxes, private enterprise, traditional values, and strong defence. Traditionally supported by business owners, middle-class and older voters. Key policies: lower taxation, privatisation, strong law and order. | Key Fact: Labour Party: centre-left, supports social justice, public services, workers' rights, and redistribution of wealth through taxation. Traditionally supported by working-class voters, trade unions and ethnic minorities.
